[!GOOS:linux] skip 'darwin-only inactive fixture needs a linux host'
[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=

# Inactive Go code that imports a platform-only LoGOs package must not
# abort eject on linux: the default helper finishes the inactive file
# story, the helper adopts it instead of skipping it, and the lowered
# form of the platform-only import is established for the support copy.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^go hook ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestgo/base.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestgo/hook_darwin.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestgoplat/only_darwin.go
grep '^//go:build darwin$' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestgoplat/only_darwin.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestgo/hook_windows.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestwinplat/only_windows.go
grep '^//go:build windows$' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestwinplat/only_windows.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}

-- dep/ejecttestgo/base.lgo --
package ejecttestgo

func Hello() string { return "go hook ok" }

-- dep/ejecttestgo/hook_darwin.go --
//go:build darwin

package ejecttestgo

import "logos/ejecttestgoplat"

// Hooked is only reachable on darwin; the import names a platform-only
// package the host load never resolves.
func Hooked() string { return ejecttestgoplat.Detail() }

-- dep/ejecttestgo/hook_windows.go --
//go:build windows

package ejecttestgo

import "logos/ejecttestwinplat"

// HookedWin is only reachable on windows; the import names a second
// platform-only package the host load never resolves.
func HookedWin() string { return ejecttestwinplat.Detail() }

-- dep/ejecttestwinplat/only_windows.lgo --
//go:build windows

package ejecttestwinplat

func Detail() string { return "windows" }

-- dep/ejecttestgoplat/only_darwin.lgo --
//go:build darwin

package ejecttestgoplat

func Detail() string { return "darwin" }

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectplat

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ejecttestgo"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ejecttestgo.Hello())
}
